entities.summary: The Presentation Monastery, also known as the Holy Presentation (Sviato-Vvedenskyi) Monastery, is a Male Orthodox Monastery of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church located in the Pecherskyi District of Kyiv, Ukraine.
